text:
Platinum Price in 2025
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2025, the LBMA platinum price rose 128.3% between 2025-01-31 ($975) and 2025-12-30 ($2,226). The highest sampled price was $2,226 in December and the lowest was $943 in February. The mean of these observations was $1,332. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
